questions.question: A body of mass 3 kg accelerates from 10 m/s to 20 m/s in 5 seconds due to the application of a force on it. Calculate the magnitude of this force (in N).
questions.solution:
Acceleration = ( final velocity – initial velocity) ÷ time taken

Here, final velocity = 20 m/s and initial velocity = 10m/s and time = 5 seconds

**Therefore**, acceleration = (20 – 10) ÷ 5

= 2 m/s².

**Now**,

Force = Mass × Acceleration

Here, force = 3 × 2

 = 6 N.

• They do not have vascular tissues which help in the transportation of water and minerals, hence, they are usually found in moist places.
 
• Thallophyta is further divided into - Algae and Fungi.

questions.question: Vishnu travels from point A to point B at the speed of 54 kmph and travels back to point A from the point B at the speed of 90 kmph. If the total time of travel taken by Vishnu is 1600 sec, then find the total distance Vishnu travel. (in km)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Average Speed = [2 × v₁ × v₂] ÷ [v₁ + v₂] = [2 × 54 × 90] ÷ [54 + 90] = 67.5 kmph.

Total time in hours = 1600 ÷ 3600 = 4/9 hours.

Total Distance = Average Speed × Total Time = 67.5 × (4/9) = 30 km.

**∴ The correct answer is 30 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99c6278cd6a62b416664077b156e539d7c17e7f157d7f6efddfa6d5068ee2d4a.png] 

**Given:** Speed A to B (v₁) = 54 kmph, Speed B to A (v₂) = 90 kmph, Total Time (T) = 1600 sec.

**Formula Used:** Time = Distance ÷ Speed; Total Distance = 2 × One-way Distance (D).

⇒ Total Time in hours = 1600 ÷ 3600 = 4/9 hours.

⇒ Let one-way distance be D. Then [D/54] + [D/90] = 4/9.

⇒ [(5D + 3D) / 270] = 4/9.

⇒ [8D / 270] = 4/9.

⇒ D = [4 × 270] ÷ [9 × 8] = 1080 ÷ 72 = 15 km.

⇒ Total Distance Traveled = 2 × D = 2 × 15 = 30 km.

**∴ The correct answer is 30 km.**

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Interest for 4 years (11 − 7) = ₹6640 − ₹5680 = **₹960**

Interest for 1 year = 960 ÷ 4 = **₹240**

**Principal (P)** = Amount after 7 years − Interest for 7 years = 5680 − (240 × 7) = **₹4000**

Rate (R) = (Interest per year ÷ Principal) × 100 = (240 ÷ 4000) × 100 = **6%**

**∴ The correct answer is 6%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Amount in 7 years (A₁) = **₹5680**

Amount in 11 years (A₂) = **₹6640**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8680ffc284be609a110bc0c6d53d105e79cb42684876d2abc6277ab95d76c3e.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Amount (A) = P + SI

**Calculations:**

⇒ Interest for (11 − 7) years = 6640 − 5680

⇒ Interest for 4 years = 960

⇒ Interest for 1 year = 960 ÷ 4 = 240

⇒ Interest for 7 years = 240 × 7 = 1680

⇒ Principal (P) = Amount after 7 years − Interest for 7 years

⇒ P = 5680 − 1680 = **4000**

⇒ Rate (R) = (Interest for 1 year × 100) ÷ Principal

⇒ R = (240 × 100) ÷ 4000

⇒ R = 24000 ÷ 4000 = **6%**

**∴ The correct answer is 6%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Constant Interest in SI

In **Simple Interest**, the interest earned remains the same every year because it is always calculated on the original **Principal**.

Effective Rate of Interest

The effective rate for **T years** is simply **(R × T)%**. For example, 6% for 7 years is 42% of the principal.

Amount Relation

The amount at the end of T years is **A = P(1 + RT/100)**.

questions.question: If a man walks at (7)/(8) of his usual speed, he reaches his office 20 minutes late than the usual time. Find the usual time he takes (in minutes).
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Speed ratio (Usual : New) = 1 : 7/8 = 8 : 7

Since **Distance** is constant, **Time** ratio is the inverse = 7 : 8

Difference in time units = 8 − 7 = 1 unit

Given 1 unit = 20 min, then **Usual Time** = 7 units × 20 = 140 min

**∴ The correct answer is 140 min.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

New Speed = 7/8 of **Usual Speed**

Time delay = 20 min

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c8b0fe41633e32e2f024e4d05285bf293e19952726daa00bc65c0091802fd04.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let usual speed be S and usual time be T.

⇒ Distance D = S × T

⇒ Also, D = (7/8)S × (T + 20)

⇒ S × T = (7/8)S × (T + 20)

⇒ T = (7/8) × (T + 20)

⇒ 8T = 7T + 140

⇒ 8T − 7T = 140

⇒ T = 140 min

**∴ The correct answer is 140 min.**

**__Additional Information__**

Inverse Variation Property

When distance is constant, speed (S) and time (T) are inversely proportional (S₁/S₂ = T₂/T₁).

Average Speed Formula

For a round trip with speeds x and y, Average Speed = 2xy / (x + y).

Unit Conversion

To convert km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18; to convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.</p

questions.question: A wire is bent to form a square of area 154 cm², If the same wire is bent to form a ring, then find the area enclosed by that ring.

Area of Square (a²) = 154 ⇒ Side (a) = √154 cm.

Perimeter = 4 × √154 cm.

Area of Circle = (Perimeter²) ÷ (4 × π) = (16 × 154) ÷ (4 × 22/7).

Area of Circle = (4 × 154 × 7) ÷ 22 = 4 × 7 × 7 = 196 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 196 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given: Area of square = 154 cm²**

Formula Used: Area of square = a²; Perimeter = 4a; Circumference = 2πr; Area of circle = πr²

⇒ a² = 154

⇒ a = √154 cm

⇒ Length of wire = Perimeter of square = 4 × √154 cm

⇒ Circumference of ring = 2 × (22/7) × r = 4√154

⇒ r = (4√154 × 7) ÷ 44 = (√154 × 7) ÷ 11

⇒ Area of ring = πr² = (22/7) × [(√154 × 7) ÷ 11]²

⇒ Area = (22/7) × (154 × 49) ÷ 121

⇒ Area = (22 × 154 × 7) ÷ 121

⇒ Area = (2 × 154 × 7) ÷ 11 = 2 × 14 × 7 = 196 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 196 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

questions.question: If the simple interest charged for 9 months be 0.12 times the money borrowed, what is the rate percent per year?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Interest for **9 months** is 12% of the **principal** (since 0.12 = 12/100).

Convert 9 months to 1 year (12 months) to find the **annual rate**.

Rate per year = (12% ÷ 9) × 12 = 16%.

**∴ The correct answer is 16%.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Let the **money borrowed (Principal)** be P.

**Simple Interest (SI)** = 0.12 × P

**Time (T)** = 9 months = 9 ÷ 12 years = 3/4 years = 0.75 years

**Formula Used:**

Rate (R) = (Simple Interest × 100) ÷ (Principal × Time)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/966def32e0bf37bc547c0ba8095f771fb1e8378ee6dae2501317dc7b1ae27308.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ R = (0.12 × P × 100) ÷ (P × 0.75)

⇒ R = (12 × P) ÷ (P × 0.75)

⇒ R = 12 ÷ 0.75

⇒ R = 1200 ÷ 75

⇒ R = 16%

**∴ The correct answer is 16%.**

**__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Formula

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100, where P is **Principal**, R is **Rate** per annum, and T is **Time** in years.

Relationship between SI and Amount

**Total Amount (A)** = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI). It represents the total money returned.

Time Conversion Rule

Always ensure **Time (T)** is in years. For months, divide by 12; for days, divide by 365.</p

questions.question: If a + b = 7 and ab = 12, then what will be the value of a² + b² ?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Apply the direct identity: **a² + b² = (a + b)² − 2ab**

Given: **a + b = 7** and **ab = 12**

Substitute the values: **7² − 2(12)**

Calculation: **49 − 24 = 25**

**∴ The correct answer is 25.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** The sum of two variables is **a + b = 7** and their product is **ab = 12**.

**Formula Used:** We use the standard algebraic identity for the square of a binomial: **(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5ed083aa73f4456b255d133cd79da8ad75cf4db635357e32de10af1762b8f5d.png] 

⇒ (a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

⇒ (7)² = a² + b² + 2(12)

⇒ 49 = a² + b² + 24

⇒ a² + b² = 49 − 24

⇒ a² + b² = 25

**∴ The correct answer is 25.**

**__Additional Information__**

Square of Difference

The identity for the square of a difference is **(a − b)² = a² + b² − 2ab**.

Difference of Squares

The factorization for the difference of two squares is **a² − b² = (a + b)(a − b)**.

Sum and Difference Relationship

The relationship between the sum and difference squares is **(a + b)² − (a − b)² = 4ab**.</p

questions.question: The curved surface area (in cm²) of a right circular cone is 2145π and the radius of its base is 33 cm. What is its volume (in cm³ )?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Slant height** (l) = **Curved Surface Area** ÷ (π × r) = 2145π ÷ (33π) = 65 cm.

**Vertical height** (h) = √(l² − r²) = √(65² − 33²) = 56 cm.

**Volume** = (1/3) × π × r² × h = (1/3) × π × 33 × 33 × 56.

**Volume** = 11 × 33 × 56 × π = 20328π cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 20328 π cm³.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Curved Surface Area (CSA)** of the cone = 2145π cm²

**Radius (r)** of the base = 33 cm

**Formula Used:**

1. **CSA** = π × r × l (where l is the **slant height**)

2. l² = r² + h² (where h is the **vertical height**)

3. **Volume (V)** = (1/3) × π × r² × h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc908337c51d811f561e63c64c72e2edb329472fabd484b7105b7096754e990a.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 2145π = π × 33 × l

⇒ l = 2145 ÷ 33

⇒ l = 65 cm

⇒ h² = l² − r²

⇒ h² = 65² − 33²

⇒ h² = (65 + 33)(65 − 33) = 98 × 32

⇒ h = √(3136) = 56 cm

⇒ Volume = (1/3) × π × 33 × 33 × 56

⇒ Volume = π × 11 × 33 × 56

⇒ Volume = 20328π cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 20328 π cm³.**

**__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area (TSA) of a Cone

The **TSA** includes both the **curved surface area** and the **base area**: TSA = πrl + πr² = πr(l + r).

Relationship with Cylinder

For the same **radius** and **height**, the **volume of a cone** is exactly 1/3rd the **volume of a cylinder**: V꜀ₒₙₑ = (1/3)V꜀yₗᵢₙdₑᵣ.

Slant Height and Pythagoras

The **radius**, **vertical height**, and **slant height** of a **right circular cone** always form a **right-angled triangle**: l = √(h² + r²).</p

questions.question: A man sold 30 articles for Rs. 100 and gained 20%. The number of articles he bought for Rs. 100 was:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Price of 1 article = **Total Price ÷ Number of articles**.

SP of 1 article = 100 ÷ 30 = 10/3.

Since **Profit = 20%**, SP = 120% of CP ⇒ CP = SP × 100 ÷ (100 + P%).

CP of 1 article = (10/3) × (100/120) = (10/3) × (5/6) = 50/18 = 25/9.

Number of articles bought for Rs. 100 = 100 ÷ (25/9) = 100 × 9 ÷ 25 = 4 × 9 = **36**.

**∴ The correct answer is 36.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given → **SP of 30 articles** = Rs. 100 | **Profit** = 20%
Formulas: CP = SP × 100 ÷ (100 + P%) | Quantity ∝ 1 ÷ Price (when total expenditure is constant)
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2c2d253491d8f909d820cc599c93eeaab89abe9d9df940cb7a38c32238d6eae.png] 
⇒ When total price (Rs. 100) is same, the ratio of **Price per article** is CP : SP = 100 : 120 = 5 : 6.
⇒ Since Price and Quantity are **inversely proportional**, the ratio of Quantity is CPqₜy : SPqₜy = 6 : 5.
⇒ Given SP quantity = 30 articles, so 5 units = 30.
⇒ 1 unit = 30 ÷ 5 = 6.
⇒ CP quantity (Number of articles bought) = 6 units = 6 × 6 = **36**.

**∴ The correct answer is 36.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Price-Quantity Inverse Relationship

If the total expenditure is constant, then Quantity is inversely proportional to Price. **Quantity × Price = Constant**.

Cost Price from Selling Price

To find CP when Profit% is given: **CP = SP × [100 ÷ (100 + Gain%)]**. To find CP when Loss% is given: **CP = SP × [100 ÷ (100 − Loss%)]**.</p

questions.question: If (sin θ+cos θ)/(sin θ-cos θ)=3, then the value of sin⁴ θ - cos⁴ θ is equal to:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply **Componendo and Dividendo**: (sin θ + cos θ + sin θ − cos θ) ÷ (sin θ + cos θ − (sin θ − cos θ)) = (3 + 1) ÷ (3 − 1).

⇒ 2 sin θ ÷ 2 cos θ = 4 ÷ 2 ⇒ tan θ = 2.

Using **Right Triangle**: perpendicular = 2, base = 1, hypotenuse = √(2² + 1²) = √5.

sin⁴ θ − cos⁴ θ = (sin² θ − cos² θ)(sin² θ + cos² θ) = sin² θ − cos² θ = (2/√5)² − (1/√5)² = 4/5 − 1/5 = 3/5.

**∴ The correct answer is 3/5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e53016cf20d48ff2b11e61d6da24b5d88e3e89c416deaaef04756799ac91fdfe.png] 

**Given:** (sin θ + cos θ) / (sin θ − cos θ) = 3

**Formula Used:** sin⁴ θ − cos⁴ θ = (sin² θ + cos² θ)(sin² θ − cos² θ); sin² θ + cos² θ = 1

⇒ sin θ + cos θ = 3(sin θ − cos θ)

⇒ sin θ + cos θ = 3 sin θ − 3 cos θ

⇒ 4 cos θ = 2 sin θ

⇒ tan θ = 2

⇒ sin θ = 2/√5 and cos θ = 1/√5

⇒ sin⁴ θ − cos⁴ θ = (sin² θ − cos² θ)(1)

⇒ (2/√5)² − (1/√5)² = 4/5 − 1/5 = 3/5

**∴ The correct answer is 3/5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Identities

Fundamental identities include sin² θ + cos² θ = 1, 1 + tan² θ = sec² θ, and 1 + cot² θ = cosec² θ.

Algebraic Difference of Powers

For even powers, a⁴ − b⁴ can be factored into (a² − b²)(a² + b²), which is very useful in trigonometric simplifications.

Componendo and Dividendo Rule

If a/b = c/d, then (a+b)/(a-b) = (c+d)/(c-d). This rule simplifies ratio-based trigonometric equations quickly.</p

questions.question: A kite is attached to a string. Find the length of the string (in m) when the height of the kite is 90 m and the string makes an angle of 30° with the ground.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

In a **30°−60°−90°** triangle, the ratio of the side opposite to 30° to the **hypotenuse** is always **1 : 2**.

Given the side opposite to 30° (height) = **90 m**.

Length of the string (hypotenuse) = 2 × Height = 2 × 90 m = **180 m**.

**∴ The correct answer is 180 m.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Height of the kite (Opposite side) = **90 m**

Angle of elevation (θ) = **30°**

**Formula Used:**

sin θ = Perpendicular / Hypotenuse

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e497a25b5ad70eacc18f7774d0b506ee30ddd6c7fb2e694b7b8afb7cf5f9358b.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ sin 30° = Height / Length of string

⇒ 1 / 2 = 90 / Length of string

⇒ Length of string = 90 × 2

⇒ Length of string = 180 m

**∴ The correct answer is 180 m.**

**__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Ratios in Right Triangles

Fundamental ratios: sin θ = P/H, cos θ = B/H, and tan θ = P/B where P=Perpendicular, B=Base, and H=Hypotenuse.

Standard Angle Values

For a 30° angle: sin 30° = 1/2, cos 30° = √3/2, and tan 30° = 1/√3.

Pythagoras Theorem

In any right-angled triangle, the square of the hypotenuse is equal to the sum of the squares of the other two sides: H² = P² + B².</p

questions.question: Radha bought an article at ₹100. If she gave 25% discount she still manages to earn 12.5% of the profit. Find the marked price of the article.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Use the direct ratio between **Cost Price (CP)** and **Marked Price (MP)**.

CP : MP = (100 − Discount%) : (100 + Profit%)

CP : MP = (100 − 25) : (100 + 12.5) = 75 : 112.5

Since CP = ₹100, then MP = (100 ÷ 75) × 112.5 = 1.333 × 112.5 = ₹150.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹150.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Cost Price (CP)** = ₹100

**Profit Percentage** = 12.5%

**Discount Percentage** = 25%

**Formula Used:**

1. Selling Price (SP) = CP × (100 + Profit%)/100

2. Marked Price (MP) = SP × 100 / (100 − Discount%)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/19f000cb21bf90f15515339876f85fe3302166629f11ef7057df536b40f8cf6e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Selling Price (SP)** = 100 × (100 + 12.5) / 100

⇒ SP = 100 × 112.5 / 100 = ₹112.5

⇒ Now, SP is obtained after giving a 25% discount on **Marked Price (MP)**.

⇒ 112.5 = MP × (100 − 25) / 100

⇒ 112.5 = MP × 75 / 100

⇒ 112.5 = MP × 3/4

⇒ MP = (112.5 × 4) / 3

⇒ MP = 450 / 3 = ₹150

**∴ The correct answer is ₹150.**

**__Additional Information__**

CP, MP, and Profit/Discount Relation

The formula CP/MP = (100 − D%)/(100 + P%) is a derived result that connects the **Cost Price** and **Marked Price** directly using profit and discount percentages.

Markup Percentage

Markup % is the percentage by which the **Marked Price** is higher than the **Cost Price**. Formula: [(MP − CP) / CP] × 100.

Successive Discounts

If two discounts d₁ and d₂ are given, the **Effective Discount** = d₁ + d₂ − (d₁ × d₂)/100.

questions.question: For what value of k, (x – 5) is a factor of x³ – 3x² + kx – 10?

⇒ **P(5) = 5³ − 3 × 5² + k × 5 − 10 = 0**

⇒ 125 − 3 × 25 + 5k − 10 = 0

questions.question: What should be the value of k for the quadratic equation x² - kx + 4 = 0, if the value of the second root is equal to the value of the first root.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

For any **quadratic equation** ax² − kx + c = 0 with **equal roots** and a = 1, the relationship is given directly by:

**k = ±2√c**

Here, c = 4.

⇒ k = ±2√4 = ±4

Since 4 is present in the options, the value of k is 4.

**∴ The correct answer is 4.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Quadratic equation: **x² − kx + 4 = 0**

The second root is equal to the first root, which means both roots are **equal** (α = β).

**Formula Used:**

For any quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0 to have equal roots, the **discriminant (D)** must be equal to zero:

**D = b² − 4ac = 0**

**Calculations:**

Comparing the given equation with ax² + bx + c = 0:

⇒ **a = 1**

⇒ **b = −k**

⇒ **c = 4**

Applying the equal roots condition:

⇒ **(−k)² − 4 × 1 × 4 = 0**

⇒ **k² − 16 = 0**

⇒ **k² = 16**

⇒ **k = √16**

⇒ **k = ±4**

Comparing with the given choices, the positive value of k is 4.

**∴ The correct answer is 4.**

**__Additional Information__**

Nature of Roots of a Quadratic Equation

For a quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0, the discriminant is D = b² − 4ac. If D > 0, roots are real and unequal. If D = 0, roots are real and equal. If D < 0, roots are imaginary.

Sum and Product of Roots

For roots α and β of ax² + bx + c = 0, the sum of roots is α + β = −b/a and the product of roots is α × β = c/a.

Quadratic Formula

The roots of ax² + bx + c = 0 can be found using the formula: x = (−b ± √(b² − 4ac)) ÷ 2a.</p

A company offers four types of successive discounts:

I. 25% and 15%

II. 30% and 10%

For the **company** (the seller), the **best offer** is the one with the **minimum total discount**.

When the **sum of discounts** is the same (25+15 = 30+10 = 35+5 = 20+20 = 40), the **effective discount** is **lowest** when the **difference** between the two discounts is **minimum**.

Differences: I (25−15=10), II (30−10=20), III (35−5=30), IV (20−20=0).

**∴ The correct answer is IV.**

For divisibility by 12, the number must be divisible by both 3 and 4.

Divisibility by 4: Last two digits 'kk' must be divisible by 4 → 00, 44, or 88 ∴ k = 0, 4, 8.
